name: follow-up-flow
example-prompts: Run the follow-up-flow graph for the metodo-de-testeo domain with these meeting events.

instructions: The user MUST provide one kebab-case domain before the graph begins.
Execute this job in Latest mode using global-info domain, only for this job.
If no organization context output exists, the graph MUST continue to follow-up-activity without a compiled organization context.
The user MUST provide one or more events or updates for the selected domain before this job executes.
Execute this job first in Latest mode using the selected domain.
If no latest follow-up output exists, the job MUST continue in Default mode without prior follow-up content.
After the Latest attempt, execute this job in Default mode using the user-provided events and any available latest follow-up or organization context.
